title: Every circuit has size at least one
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables. Then the size of $C$ — the total number of literal leaves and internal AND/OR gates — is at least $1$; that is, $1 \le \mathrm{size}(C)$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a Boolean circuit on n variables
replaced: For every Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ inputs, $1 \le C.\texttt{size}$.
